ItemID: NA; Title: Dave Koz and Friends: Summer Horns; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Instrumental horn music is less appealing right now than the vocal holiday albums in my recent listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazing 50s Stereo Jukebox; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A broad oldies collection does not give me a strong reason to try it today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Stages; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not suggest the holiday songs or vocal harmonies I am looking for.
ItemID: NA; Title: PTXmas; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Holiday vocal harmonies appeal to me, but I would pick just one Christmas album this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Viva Duets; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Duets might interest me another time, but this does not connect strongly enough with my current listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: That's Christmas To Me; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Christmas songs with vocal harmonies fit my recent holiday albums and interest in The New Old Fashioned; this would be my pick.
ItemID: NA; Title: Oscd Ad Adele 21; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in holiday ensemble vocals than a solo pop album right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Passione; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not see a clear connection to the Christmas music and vocal groups I have been choosing.
ItemID: NA; Title: Harry Potter And The Goblet Of Fire; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for vocal music, and this title does not suggest that fit.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Essential Ray Price; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A country retrospective is not what I am seeking on this visit.
